title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.7.1 reduces CPU usage during editing by debouncing decoration scans and caching symbol lookups in the semantic token provider.

highlights.title: Debounced Decoration Scans
highlights.description: Typing no longer triggers a full document scan on every keystroke. Null-assertion, hex color, and string resource decorations are now updated 100 ms after you stop typing.

highlights.title: Faster Semantic Highlighting
highlights.description: A per-document word cache eliminates redundant symbol lookups — symbols that appear many times in a file are now resolved only once per highlighting pass.

sections.heading: Performance
bullets: Debounced the keystroke-driven decoration scan in `NullAssertionProvider`, `HexColorFoldingProvider`, and `StringResourceFoldingProvider` — rapid typing no longer triggers a full O(n) document scan on every character.
Added a per-document word cache in `SemanticTokensProvider` to eliminate redundant `resolveBest()` calls for symbols that appear multiple times in the same file.
